text: ①サファリ　ゾーンに　おちている　いしころです！

structure.jp: ①サファリ　ゾーンに　おちている
structure.en: ① lying on the ground in the Safari Zone

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: サファリ　ゾーンに　おちている　いしころ
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a thing tells you which one is meant. サファリ　ゾーンに　おちている　いしころ = 'a Rock lying in the Safari Zone'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb shows the state left after the action: it fell and is still there. おちている = 'is lying on the ground'.
